notes.title: VOYAGERS IS OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950303/8f39ddb38915f0131d58da9cc82d33f5b3a84d5c.png[/img]

Thank you much for your patience and support. 
"Voyagers" has been released and is available for purchase. 
Sorry for the delay on the announcement, there has been a problem with the event system.

notes.title: VOYAGERS RELEASE
notes.content:
[b]Hi,[/b]

The build version is finally ready. I made the last few adjustments to prepare the game for release. Friday the 22nd of November will be the release date. Stay tuned!

Enki.
